title: Energy-Efficient and Carbon-Aware Scheduling in Cloud Computing using an Enhanced Whale Optimization Algorithm (CA-WOA): code, data and reproducibility artefacts
description:
Complete reproducibility artefact for a study of carbon-aware temporal workload shifting in cloud data centres. Contains a vectorised scheduling simulator behind a 27-check validation gate that reproduces the originally published figures to machine precision, 29 experiments with one row per (configuration, method, seed) across 30 independent seeds, five real half-hourly grid carbon-intensity traces (UK, Republic of Ireland, Northern Ireland, US California, US Mid-Atlantic), and the analysis and forecasting scripts.

Includes a theoretical treatment of the constrained-scheduling baseline and a Markov-chain convergence analysis. Two experiments are deliberately retained and labelled INVALID, documenting modelling errors that were detected and corrected.
